name: Sunken Ruins
defaultDescriptions: You are deep within the Sunken Ruins. The damp subterranean air carries the faint hum of ancient, corrupted arcane energy. Crumbling stone arches and cracked flagstones lie half-buried in dark moss.
Bioluminescent fungi cast an eerie purple glow against the damp carved masonry. Distant groans of corrupted sentinels echo down the winding corridors.

4,5: You stand at the foot of a cracked stone staircase leading back up toward the surface light of the Whispering Woods.
Cool surface air filters down through the shattered ceiling vault above the entrance stairs.
4,1: You stand before the central sanctum altar. A pulsating Dark Heart Core is anchored atop an obsidian dais, surrounded by arcane runes.
The air here crackles with intense, suffocating dark essence. An elite Corrupted Vanguard stands guard over the chamber.

ruins_entrance: Stairway of weathered granite leading upwards toward safety.
ancient_corridor: A long, vaulted stone hallway littered with shattered statuary and arcane residue.
cracked_altar: A blasphemous altar of blackened stone where an unholy core feeds corruptive tendrils into the surrounding earth.

triggers.label: Confront Corrupted Vanguard
triggers.tooltip: Approach the sanctum altar to challenge the guardian of the Dark Heart Core.
triggers.description: A hulking, armor-clad vanguard wreathed in demonic shadow turns to face you, raising a massive jagged blade.
